shortTitle: Commentary: Leveraging Historical Patient Data in Diabetes Care
longTitle: Commentary: Leveraging historical patient data to identify undiagnosed diabetes and prediabetes in routine care
summary: This commentary discusses the excellent research from Bowen et.al. who developed and validated an EHR-based risk score to improve screening in safety net hospitals
citation: Li Z., Ali M.K. and Varghese J.S. Leveraging historical patient data to identify undiagnosed diabetes and prediabetes in routine care. Diabetes Care. 2025;48(5):682-684. doi:10.2337/dci25-0011
